nodes.rationale: Implement, run tests/build/app, then one fresh reviewer sub-agent checking requirements, the running app, obvious bugs and regressions; max one fix round; skip the reviewer for tiny changes; a multi-round Gauntlet only when explicitly requested. Optimize for tokens and the fewest agents.
